name: Summon Greater Fire Elemental
description: (Tag:spirit)(Tag:summon)Conjure powerful Greater Fire Elementals from your energy and command them, such as Firebirds, Greater Efreets, Flame Devourers, etc., using fire-based magic and other abilities. Limited to Elite Familiar power or less; power and form scale with your expertise and level. They draw on your energy to persist and act, vanishing if supply stops, but with enough time, energy, and skill you can make them permanent. Elementals are not counted as Familiars by the system.
